prs.title: Switch sorting from merge sort to quick sort
prs.body:
Replaces the merge sort implementation with quick sort (middle-element pivot, three-way partition).

- `POST /sort` now uses quick sort (O(n log n) average, O(n^2) worst case).
- `POST /sort/steps` now returns **partition** steps (`pivot`, `before`, `equal`, `after`) instead of merge steps (`left`, `right`, `merged`). This is a breaking change to the response schema.
- API renamed to **Sort API**, version 2.0.0.
- Tests updated.

---
**Code only:** this PR changes `main.py` and tests, nothing else. All docs, including the OpenAPI reference, live in [`mintlify-demo/docs`](https://github.com/mintlify-demo/docs) under `merge-sort-api/`. Mintlify's *Update from code changes* automation picks up this change and opens the docs PR there.

_Part of the mintlify-demo stack. Reset nightly to `demo-baseline`._

prs.title: Add algorithm parameter to /sort (quick, merge, heap)
prs.body:
Adds an optional `algorithm` field to the sort request: `quick` (default), `merge` (stable), or `heap`.

- The response echoes `algorithm`.
- `/sort/steps` always uses quick sort.
- Unknown algorithms return `422`.
- Tests for every algorithm.

prs.title: Add power and modulo operations to /v2/calculate
prs.body:
Adds two new operations to the v2 `operation` enum:

- `power`: folds left to right, so `[2, 3, 2]` is `(2 ** 3) ** 2 = 64`.
- `modulo`: remainder, so `[17, 5]` is `2`. Modulo by zero returns `400`.
- Tests added.
